title: iEEG Can Help EEG: Improving Clinical Scalp EEG Analysis through Intracranial Priors
abstract: arXiv:2611.20435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is a cornerstone of clinical brain monitoring, making the quality of its signal fundamental to downstream tasks and models. However, that signal is heavily contaminated by non-neural interference and blurred by volume conduction. Existing methods operate almost exclusively within the scalp modality, so they inherit the contamination they would need to overcome. In practice, intracranial EEG (iEEG) observes the neural activity with far higher fidelity, yet it is invasive and therefore scarce, and the two modalities are rarely recorded as pairs at scale, share no common channel space, and offer no clean ground truth to directly supervise a mapping. Motivated by the neuronal synchronization mechanism shared by the two modalities, we propose a reprogramming approach that fits a signal-to-signal model on iEEG alone and freezes it as a cross-modal prior. translated_title: iEEG可以帮助EEG：通过颅内先验改进临床头皮脑电分析
translated_abstract: 头皮脑电图（EEG）是临床脑监测的基石，其信号质量对下游任务和模型至关重要。然而，该信号受到非神经干扰的严重污染，并因容积传导效应而变得模糊。现有方法几乎完全在头皮模态内部运行，因此它们继承了自身本需要克服的污染。在实践中，颅内脑电图（iEEG）能够以远更高的保真度观测神经活动，但它具有侵入性，因而数据稀缺，且两种模态很少能大规模成对记录，不具备共同的通道空间，也没有干净的ground truth来直接监督映射。受两种模态共享的神经元同步机制启发，我们提出了一种重编程方法，仅在iEEG上拟合信号到信号的模型并将其冻结为跨模态先验。我们提出了ReBrain框架，用于将iEEG信息迁移至
tldr: 提出ReBrain框架，通过将高保真颅内脑电模型冻结为跨模态先验，重编程头皮脑电信号以克服其固有污染与容积传导模糊问题，从而提升临床脑电分析质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes ReBrain, a framework that freezes a high-fidelity iEEG signal-to-signal model as a cross-modal prior to reprogram contaminated scalp EEG, improving clinical brain monitoring analysis.
